AppImages built by pb can now be installed with AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever and other integration tools.

## Fixes

- **Every AppImage carries a `.desktop` entry and an icon.** The AppImage format expects them at the root of the image, and integration tools refuse files without them. Before, pb only added them for GUI apps, so CLI AppImages ran fine but couldn't be installed. Now CLI tools get an entry with `Terminal=true` and a simple terminal icon, and GUI apps use their own icon. The `.deb` and `.rpm` of a CLI tool still contain just the binary.
- `.DirIcon` is set, so file managers show the icon too.

## Upgrade

```sh
sudo pb update
```

Or grab a binary or package below. `sha256sums.txt` has the checksums.
